confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given July peak demand. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (about 1.6x and 1.45x a draft beer) because direct price knowledge is weak. Yen figures, and so the USD anchors, assume about 150 JPY per USD, not a live rate. FX is unverified: I could not open the RBA exchange-rates page or its daily table, and the 0.7088 value is the newest RBA figure a search summary reported, dated 2026-03-20. It is about seven months old and not confirmed as the latest observation, so re-check the RBA table before converting.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Hiroshima is treated as a mid-sized Japanese regional city: restaurant and drink prices near regional averages, and accommodation priced below Kyoto and Osaka.
